The discriminant condition is  
\[
\Delta=9b^2+28b+20>0 \implies b<-2 \text{ or } b>-\frac{10}{9}.
\]
Since \(a=-1-b\) is a positive integer, \(b<-1\), and \(b\) is an integer. Combining with the discriminant condition, \(b=-2\) is excluded because \(\Delta=0\), and no integer \(b\) lies in \((-10/9,-1)\). Thus the largest possible integer \(b\) is \(-3\).

Then
\[
b+c=3b+5=3(-3)+5=-4.
\]

\[
\boxed{-4}
\]
